hypothesis: Keep M's complete-string certificate and exact fixed 97-scalar mapping. A compiled character-class-plus substitution copies unchanged spans and calls the same translate table only on maximal adjacent runs of those 97 compatibility scalars. This may avoid mapping lookups on long unchanged Han/ASCII spans. Sparse and dense cases can differ; callback, match and substring costs are unknown and no numeric speedup is claimed. Multiple separated runs can increase callback/translate call counts despite reducing translated receiver characters; both are recorded without equating fewer translated characters with faster recall.

allowed_runtime_change.callback: Return match.group().translate(_NORMALIZATION_TRANSLATION) with the existing table, without normalizing, casefolding, caching, modifying the match, or translating unmatched spans.
allowed_runtime_change.call_site: Replace only text.translate(_NORMALIZATION_TRANSLATION) inside the existing successful _NORMALIZATION_COMPATIBILITY.fullmatch(text) branch with compiled_pattern.sub(callback, text). Keep identity_source=True in its existing position.
allowed_runtime_change.guards: Keep the single historical initial isascii truth evaluation; exact native str, recognized UCD, normalize/category/Camel/strip identity guards; K identity-first branch; whole-string extended alphabet match; unknown-version, unsupported Unicode, custom hooks and subclass literal fallback.
allowed_runtime_change.order: Translate every run within the original complete string before the original whole-string CamelCase substitution and casefold. No per-run CamelCase/casefold; no omitted or reordered scalar.
allowed_runtime_change.proof: The regex covers exactly the 97 existing table keys and greedily partitions every admitted compatible occurrence into disjoint maximal runs. str.translate is the same pointwise mapping on those runs; all unmatched certified identity scalars are unchanged. Their concatenation therefore equals M's full-string translate exactly. M's existing whole-string Unicode stability, non-Mn/combining-class-zero and casefold-closure proof still supplies NFKC/NFKD equivalence.
allowed_runtime_change.source_inverse: Removing exactly the new compiled-pattern block and helper block and restoring the one call-site line must reproduce the entire frozen LM text.py byte-for-byte.
